scope: Bounded visual inspection after the Astra review. The final additional Astra follow-up could not run because its usage limit was reached; these observations are not attributed to that reviewer.

observations.result: The previously clipped triangular sector is gone. Concentric seating and the outer grade apron form a continuous bowl. Position and elevations remain estimated.

Tower-facing ribbons are attached and curve toward the mall podium. Garden, arched chapel and egg-shaped hall remain visible. This is an inferred architectural interpretation, not an exact facade survey.
Tower occludes much of the mall from this fixed direction; use AERIAL and ROOF_OBLIQUE for the roof-to-tower relationship.
Live preview confirms older mapped tree and cafe props no longer intersect the active amphitheater terrain. No console errors were returned.

performance_revision_limit: The matched benchmarks preceded the final local-terrain prop exclusion, which removes overlapping instances. Initial Inspect pairs also preceded the broad mapped-tree crown change. Figures are route-specific, not a whole-city performance guarantee.
remaining_evidence_gaps: Current artwork positions and reproduction rights
